pattern.description: A new 'Finding files...' tool-step card is appended at the bottom of the left agent pane and the whole conversation stack jumps up inside the fixed pane to make room; the right pane stays still.
pattern.why_premium: The scroll is driven by real agent progress, so the viewer reads the agent working step by step; the pane mask and fixed 'Thinking...' footer keep the frame calm while content advances.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.left .stack', {y: '-=96', duration: 0.07, ease: 'steps(2)'}); gsap.fromTo('.left .step-card:last-child', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.03, ease: 'none'}, '<'); pane has overflow:hidden as the mask.
build_hint.remotion: stack translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 2], [0, -96], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) inside an overflow:hidden pane; new card opacity = frame >= 1 ? 1 : 0. No spring: terminal-style hard redraw.

notes: Motion energy sits in two adjacent frames, consistent with a near-instant redraw rather than an eased scroll; shift amount is a visual estimate. Camera move is none.
